about: Five real complaints for the demo. 'next' is hindsight shown only after the decision, never given to the system.

cases.title: Known recall, superseded recall, complaints after the remedy
cases.story: 2024 Ioniq 5 loses drive power (ICCU). Two recalls describe it; 24V204 was replaced by 24V868. 75 similar complaints arrived after the 24V868 remedy was published: the fix may not hold, or cars are not being repaired.

cases.title: Same vehicle and component, opposite failure
cases.story: 2022 Acura MDX: airbags did not deploy in a crash with fire and injury. The only airbag recall (24V064) is about an airbag deploying when it should be suppressed. A naive vehicle+component lookup would call this a known recall.

cases.title: Possible new defect, escalated early
cases.story: 2018 Honda Ridgeline rear camera fails because tailgate use pinches the wiring. None of the 4 recalls on the vehicle fits; 4 similar complaints in the prior 10 months.
cases.next: NHTSA recall 22V867000 (filed 2022-11-23, influenced by ODI): 'Opening and closing the tailgate may break the rearview camera wiring harness'. 348 days after this complaint.

cases.title: Too little to go on
cases.story: 'Backup camara is not working' - no symptom detail, conditions or warnings; the system should ask, not guess.

cases.title: AI failure
cases.story: Same complaint as D1 with the model unavailable: the rules-only fallback answers, clearly labelled 'not AI-verified'.
